I need to decide whether to buy or auction the property at Kentucky Avenue.

I have $1143 and three properties. p3 owns a complete light blue set. p2 and p4 each hold dark blue monopolies. I am weighing the $220 purchase against starting an auction.

I own zero red properties. Indiana is with p2, so completing the red group would require trading later. Buying Kentucky leaves $923 cash.

I should buy Kentucky Avenue. Denying p2 the second red property prevents them from completing a red monopoly with Indiana and Illinois. I will keep it as a trade asset. p3's complete light blue set is dangerous because they can build houses.

p3 does not have a light blue monopoly. Oriental belongs to p4, so the light blue set is split between two players.
